observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor studio with green walls, likely a dance class or fitness video
observation.posture: upright torso, knees bent, weight shifts between feet
observation.footwork: rhythmic stepping, including side-to-side steps, kicks, and hops; precise footwork is difficult to see due to camera cuts and video speed
observation.arms_and_hands: arms move in coordinated patterns, often raised or extended; hands are sometimes held in fists or open, occasionally wearing white gloves
observation.hips_and_torso: some hip movement and torso swaying, but mostly controlled
observation.costume_and_props: two sets of costumes: one casual (tank tops and leggings) and one traditional (ornate, colorful dresses with hats and white gloves)
observation.cannot_infer: exact weight transfer and fast footwork are difficult to see due to camera cuts and video speed

signature_moments.what: dancers in traditional costume perform a coordinated turn with arms raised
dancers in traditional costume perform a synchronized squat with arms extended
dancers in traditional costume perform a series of hops with alternating leg kicks
dancers in traditional costume perform a spin with arms extended, showing the skirt movement
dancers in traditional costume link arms and perform a synchronized side-step
